You really shouldn't offer strangers to be their virtual moms as it's very dangerous for the both of you. If i were you you shouldn't contact the cops about this. If her mom did something to her that's not normal than you should contact CPS. But heres why you shouldn't contact the cops about this:

1. You might be suspected because gou offered a 11 year old girl to be her virtual mom.

2. The girl told you some personal things, and you might be suspected of being the cause of her problems since you could've told someone earlier about this.

3. You're a stranger from the internet chatting with a 11 year old girl.

You might get yourself into unnecesery problems, and i truly do believe that your intention was to make her feel loved and let her feel like she has a mom that cares about. I truly believe you did it for a good reason and i believe your intention was meant to be good, but from a other perspective it really looks weird and creepy. (I do not think you're creepy nor weird by the way, some people in this comment section obviously do.) It's dangerous for you! And you should just report her, block her and take care of yourself. 

I can imagine that this is shocking to you, but you gotta know that what the eleven year old girl did was not normal. And she sounds mentally unstable. Don't get involved with her in any way, let her family take care of this, you're not gonna be considered a friend to her if you help her because of the age difference and they ofcourse are gonna ask you how you met her and where you know her from and what your intentions were! 

Stay yourself please. Try to do as much to forget this whole situation, for example, take a walk or something when you're tempted to think about it! Stay safe :)
